title: Towards a Thriving Workplace: A Feasibility Study on Mindfulness and the Mediterranean Lifestyle for Corporate Wellness
content: This study investigates the feasibility of integrating mindfulness and the Mediterranean lifestyle into corporate wellness programs, focusing on their potential to enhance workplace well-being. A survey of 485 employees from Greece and Cyprus examined the relationships between mindfulness, resilience, adherence to the Mediterranean lifestyle, and work ability. Pearson correlation analysis revealed strong positive associations between mindfulness, resilience, and work ability. Mindfulness was also a significant predictor of higher work ability and job satisfaction, while adherence to the Mediterranean lifestyle showed a modest, but positive, correlation with resilience and work ability. A notable finding was the sector-specific disparities in wellness scores, with employees in health and retail sectors demonstrating lower levels of resilience, work ability, and mindfulness compared to those in other sectors. Participants showed a high willingness to participate in future corporate wellness interventions, particularly those combining online and onsite formats. These results suggest that mindfulness and the Mediterranean lifestyle can positively influence employee well-being and productivity, and that sector-specific strategies may be needed to address gaps in workplace wellness. Future research should explore the long-term effects of such interventions and their applicability across different industries and employee groups.
